market.title: OpenAI delaying IPO amid AI safety concerns, Sam Altman says
market.summary: OpenAI will not go public this year given all the safety work it needs to do, CEO Sam Altman said in a Fortune interview released Saturday. Why it matters: Altman's comments come as fears over doomsday AI scenarios have ramped up since an Anthropic employee resigned and issued a dire warning about AI's capabilities. What they're saying: "Right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public," Altman said . "I would say not 2026, yeah. We got a lot of stuff to do," Altman told Fortune editor-in-chief Alyson Shontell. "Meeting this moment of what is going to be required for safety and alignment, and how the industry and governments can work together, I'm happy to be able to do that as a private company." The intrigue: The market expected blockbuster IPOs from both OpenAI and Anthropic this year. Altman's move puts the ball squarely in Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's court — especially given Amodei's warning Saturday that AI development needs to be slowed. The bottom line: " I think a key principle that we should all agree on is that we cannot take actions that would risk losing control of the future to AI," Altman said. That means investors may have to wait a while. Editor's note: This story has been updated with new information throughout.

market.title: Elon Musk backs Anthropic’s call to slow down AI progress before rogue bots take over the entire internet
market.summary: Leaders of major AI companies say they agree with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, who just called for the tech industry to move more slowly with model development.

market.title: Anthropic, OpenAI CEOs call for slowdown in AI development
market.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is calling for an immediate slowdown in the pace of AI development, warning of potentially devastating consequences in a matter of months otherwise. Why it matters: Amodei pulled no punches in a new essay , cautioning that swarms of rogue AI agents could take over the internet in as little as six months from now. What they're saying : "We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models. Progress will still seem fast, and we must make wise use of the time we gain," Amodei wrote. Threat level : Amodei specifically referenced the recent OpenAI-Hugging Face rogue agent incident , which he said could have been far worse. "Given the accelerating rate of AI capability development, it's my worry that in 6–12 months such a swarm could be capable of taking over the entire internet with a persistent botnet (potentially causing hundreds of billions of dollars in damage), and that the scale of damage would continue to increase from there if AI becomes more powerful without the necessary guardrails," he warned. Zoom out : Amodei said Anthropic would unilaterally take one key safety measure — giving external evaluators employee-level access to ensure safety procedures and report incidents. He called on the rest of the industry to do the same. He also called for coordination among democratic countries to establish safety standards, and an effort for those countries to coordinate with authoritarian governments as well. The intrigue: SpaceXAI's Elon Musk quickly endorsed Amodei's call to action. "Dario is right," he wrote on X. (Anthropic is a major customer of Musk's for data center capacity.) Zoom in: Anthropic executives followed Amodei's essay with a call for legislative and regulatory responses. "The government has a critical role to play here, including blocking the sale of the most advanced chips to adversarial nations like China, enacting a national law requiring testing of frontier models, with the power to block the most advanced models that prove to be unsafe," public policy chief Sarah Heck wrote on X. The big picture : This is the week that the AI safety debate broke into the public consciousness, driven by an Anthropic employee's very public resignation and warning of possible doom . Amodei's essay isn't necessarily a direct response, but it will have much the same effect amid a sudden surge of public and congressional outrage. " The measures I propose to advance the frontier at a safe pace will not be easy. But I believe we owe it to humanity to try," Amodei wrote in concluding his essay. Reality check : So much money is at stake in the AI industry that it can be hard to imagine companies restraining themselves, especially if they're not sure competitors will do the same. Just last month, OpenAI said it would slow development of its newest model, Astra, due to cybersecurity concerns. Anthropic itself has gone back and forth on the value of unilaterally slowing development. In fact, Amodei's critics suggested the essay was as much about market position as safety. "Dario makes the case to stop open source and concentrate enormous technological and economic power with Anthropic," venture capitalist Chamath Palihapitiya wrote on X. The bottom line : Amodei's essay is likely to have a significant impact on the safety and regulatory debate. But whether anyone acts, or if the industry simply continues hurtling toward an incredibly uncertain future, remains to be seen. Editor's note: This story has been updated with additional context throughout.

headlines.title: X Pay is live on mainnet
headlines.summary: X Pay has launched a payment gateway that enables any API or software to charge for individual HTTP requests and settle in USDC on Base mainnet. headlines.summary: The global industrial degreaser market is projected to grow from USD 6.85 billion in 2025 to USD 11.18 billion by 2035, with a CAGR of 5.02%. Growth is driven by increasing industrial automation, rising demand for low-VOC and eco-friendly formulations, and expanding electric vehicle production. Solvent-based degreasers dominate with 47.60% market share, though water-based alternatives are growing rapidly at 6.30% CAGR.

headlines.title: Illinois Tool Exhibits Strong Prospects Despite Persisting Headwinds
headlines.summary: Illinois Tool Works (ITW) demonstrates broad-based growth across welding, electronics, and construction segments with 3-4% expected organic revenue growth in 2026. Enterprise initiatives added 120 basis points to operating margin. However, the company faces headwinds from weak automotive production and soft foodservice demand, with cost pressures impacting margins.

headlines.title: Uber's AV Ambitions in Spain Gain Momentum: More Growth Ahead?
headlines.summary: Uber, WeRide, and AVOMO have secured Spain's first national permit for Level 4 autonomous passenger vehicles. The Madrid rollout will begin with 20 WeRide-equipped vehicles, targeting commercial service by end-2026. This marks Uber's entry into European autonomous mobility through an asset-light partnership model, with plans to expand to 15 cities by 2030.

headlines.title: Solid Demand in Commercial Aerospace Drives Howmet: Can It Sustain?
headlines.summary: Howmet Aerospace (HWM) reported robust Q2 2026 results driven by 28% growth in commercial aerospace revenues, which now represent 53% of its business. Engine Products revenues jumped 32% to $1.37B, while Fastening Systems grew 37% year-over-year. The company's $1.8B acquisition of Stanley Black & Decker's CAM business strengthened its aerospace fastening portfolio. With Boeing's 737 MAX recovery and strong Airbus build rates, Howmet is positioned for continued momentum.

headlines.title: Can Northrop Grumman's European Expansion Drive Growth?
headlines.summary: Northrop Grumman is expanding its defense operations in Central and Eastern Europe through new industrial agreements in Poland and Estonia, capitalizing on NATO allies' increased defense investments. The company is deepening partnerships on Bushmaster Chain Guns production, IBCS command systems, and the E-2D Hawkeye platform, positioning itself to benefit from Europe's focus on strengthening defense capabilities and domestic manufacturing.

headlines.title: Delta-Hyatt Alliance to Boost Loyalty and Premium Travel Appeal
headlines.summary: Delta Air Lines announced a strategic partnership with Hyatt to integrate their loyalty programs, enabling SkyMiles members to earn rewards on hotel stays and World of Hyatt members to earn points on Delta flights. The collaboration aims to strengthen Delta's loyalty ecosystem and enhance the premium travel experience, though the full financial impact remains unclear pending more details on eligibility and benefits.

headlines.title: KE vs. ROK: Which Stock Is the Better Value Option?
headlines.summary: A comparison of two Electronics - Miscellaneous Products stocks reveals that Kimball Electronics (KE) presents a better value opportunity than Rockwell Automation (ROK). KE has a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) with stronger earnings estimate revisions, a lower forward P/E of 16.46 versus ROK's 31.84, and a Value grade of A compared to ROK's D grade.

headlines.title: Macy's (M) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
headlines.summary: Macy's reported Q2 2026 earnings of $0.40 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.37, with revenues of $4.87 billion slightly exceeding expectations. The company has consistently beaten estimates over the last four quarters. Despite the positive earnings surprise, Macy's shares have underperformed the S&P 500 year-to-date, declining 2.5% versus the market's 11.6% gain. The stock received a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating based on favorable estimate revision trends, though future performance will depend on management guidance.

headlines.summary: Newsweek announced its fourth annual World's Most Trustworthy Companies ranking, recognizing 1,000 companies across 20 countries based on customer, employee, and investor trust. Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, Campbell's, Nintendo, Samsung SDS, Linde, Clorox, and Tesco ranked No. 1 in their respective industries. The ranking evaluated over 65,000 survey participants and 200,000 company evaluations across three trust dimensions.

headlines.title: Will Sysco's $500M AI Push Support Its Higher Growth Targets?
headlines.summary: Sysco Corporation announced a multi-year AI-powered efficiency program targeting at least $500 million in cost savings by fiscal 2029. The company reaffirmed its fiscal 2027 outlook with net sales growth of 6-7% and adjusted EPS growth of 9-11%, while raising fiscal 2028-2029 guidance. AI initiatives will focus on truck routing, warehouse productivity, procurement, and back-office automation.

headlines.title: Can Approved Rate Hikes Drive American Water Works' Long-Term Growth?
headlines.summary: American Water Works (AWK) received approval for a $68 million annual revenue increase in New Jersey effective September 15, 2026, supporting its 7-9% long-term earnings growth target through 2030. The rate hike will fund $1.4 billion in infrastructure upgrades while increasing average residential bills by approximately $4 monthly. AWK plans $19-20 billion in capital investments through 2030 to support 8-9% rate-base growth. The stock trades at a premium valuation with a forward P/E of 21.77X versus the industry average of 17.57X and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

headlines.title: Wynson Securities Limited Announces Continued Progress on NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy Combination
headlines.summary: NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy announced continued progress on their proposed all-stock combination following shareholder approval on September 3, 2026. The merger would create one of the largest U.S. electric utility platforms serving approximately 10 million customer accounts across Florida, Virginia, North Carolina, and South Carolina, with combined generation capacity of 110 gigawatts. Dominion Energy shareholders will receive 0.8138 NextEra Energy shares per share owned, with the transaction expected to close in the second half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals.

GOOG.title: X Pay is live on mainnet
GOOG.summary: X Pay has launched a payment gateway that enables any API or software to charge for individual HTTP requests and settle in USDC on Base mainnet. The service eliminates traditional payment barriers like accounts, API keys, and subscriptions by leveraging the x402 standard and stablecoins, allowing economically viable micropayments for the first time. The x402 standard, contributed by Coinbase and managed by the Linux Foundation, has already processed over 169 million payments across 590,000 buyers and 100,000 sellers.

GOOG.title: Computer History Museum Announces "Extended Reality: Visions of the Future" Exhibit
GOOG.summary: The Computer History Museum announced the opening of 'Extended Reality: Visions of the Future,' a new exhibit running from October 1, 2026 to March 28, 2027, showcasing over 100 XR devices and wearables tracing the evolution from pioneering 1960s systems to today's AI-enabled smart glasses. The exhibit explores how AI is transforming wearable computing and features artifacts from major tech companies including Meta, Google, and Apple.

GOOG.title: ADBE Rides on Acrobat AI Expansion: Can it Outpace MSFT & GOOGL?
GOOG.summary: Adobe is transforming Acrobat into an AI-powered document productivity platform with features like conversational PDF editing and content creation. While adoption metrics show strong growth—Acrobat AI Assistant paid MAUs surged over 150% and ARR tripled year-over-year—Adobe faces intensifying competition from Microsoft's Copilot and Google's Gemini in document workflows. Despite strong product momentum, ADBE stock has declined 27.1% year-to-date and carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.

GOOG.title: AI Labs Integrates Google’s Gemini into AIV Chatbot to Launch Next-Generation Investment Analytics Platform
GOOG.summary: Singapore-based AI Labs has integrated Google's Gemini AI into its AIV Chatbot, creating an advanced investment analytics platform for analyzing cryptocurrencies and technology stocks. The platform organizes investment research around market outlook, technical analysis, fundamentals and risk, presenting structured analysis rather than simple buy/sell signals. Gemini's multimodal capabilities enable the chatbot to analyze earnings releases, market data, charts and financial documents, with potential to evolve into an interactive investment research assistant accessible to retail investors.
